content:
Grouping from the datasheet: two orderable parts (LQD-M31400-DR4C vs LQ4-M31400-DR4C) → two modes. Shared 400G-DR4 electrical/optical specs apply to both except form factor. Low power (1.5 W) is a power state, not a separate application mode. Rx -4.6 dBm (SOMA) vs -2.6 dBm (SRS) are test conditions on the same receiver, not separate modes.
